messages:
alyssa: heads up — sampleapp embeddings + rerank is blowing up in prod for a customer. getting a shape error when we call the rerank endpoint after batching
alyssa: stack: 
```
ValueError: matrices are not aligned: (batch=8, dim=1536) dot (dim=768, items=5)
```
alyssa: looks like the embed helper is padding some vectors to 1536 but the model we serve returns 768, so rerank receives mixed dims
sam: hmm that's weird — which SDK and language?
alyssa: Node sampleapp (latest sdk 0.6.2), but I repro in Python too with the new batching helper enabled
sam: could be the default batcher pad_to_max flag — Node defaulted to true in the last minor, py default false. that would explain a mixed batch if one client pads and the other doesn't
devex-jen: @sam — we had an issue open about pad_to_max parity but it was closed as "minor". can you paste the exact request body?
alyssa: sure — this is the client side batching call (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
{
  "model": "open-embed-1",
  "inputs": ["..." * 8],
  "batcher": { "max_batch_tokens": 2048, "pad_to_max": true }
}
```
alyssa: then we call rerank like: 
```
POST /v1/rerank
{ "query_embedding": <float array len=1536>, "candidate_embeddings": [<float array len=768>, ...] }
```
tolga: oof — two separate problems: (1) pad_to_max creating 1536 outputs for some clients, (2) rerank expecting uniform dim across candidates. did the SDKs expose the model's embedding_dim anywhere?
sam: currently only the metadata endpoint returns dims, and only the hosted API attaches it to model catalog not to SDK responses. parity gap for sure
devex-jen: UX/onsite note: onboarding sampleapp prints "embedding created" without dims — new users never notice mismatch until rerank fails. that's bad DX
alyssa: customer hit it during a canary, took down a small feature. they had a mix of old and new sampleapps in their infra
tolga: root cause: Node SDK changed default pad_to_max, Python didn't. second-order: rerank SDK method doesn't validate dims and tries to assemble tensors which fails in runtime
sam: quick mitigation: add client-side check in sampleapp that asserts all embeddings have same length before sending to rerank and log a helpful error + upload diag bundle to support
devex-jen: also add model_dim to EmbeddingResponse in both SDKs so parity is explicit. open PR?
alyssa: opened github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/412 with the assert and a nicer error message. link in thread.
ci-bot: build passed for sampleapp PR #412 :white_check_mark:
tolga: long-term: make server annotate embeddings with "embedding_dim" in batch response and have rerank auto-cast/fail-fast with a clear error code (400 + code EMB_DIM_MISMATCH)
sam: agree. also standardize pad_to_max default to false across SDKs and mention it in changelog
devex-jen: add a small e2e test to CI that runs Node+Python sampleapps mixing versions to catch cross-client parity regressions
alyssa: thanks everyone — rolled the assert to prod as emergency hotfix and notified customer. will follow up with dims metadata change PR
sam: I'll own the SDK parity PR to expose embedding_dim and pad_to_max consistency. cc @devex-jen for release notes
alyssa: closing loop — customer confirmed feature back up after hotfix :thumbsup:
